_doc: Paint, refutation round 1 (2026-11-23). Overlays of the first lap-wide assembly on boxes not used for tuning, read by eye; counts are by eye and approximate (a fragment is hard to count exactly). 20 boxes were drawn (refute.py r1: junctions at s 515, 1327, 1910, 2640, 2945, 3940, 4200, 4880, 5510, 6250; mid-block at s 150, 800, 1260, 2100, 2720, 3500, 3850, 4300, 5200, 5950); 4 were read before the causes were plain and the rest were not counted. The inventory was then rebuilt, so these numbers describe the state BEFORE the fixes below.

boxes_read.what: false: paving bands and a planter edge on the Civic Center plaza read as bars and a line (the look-window reached past the kerb); crosswalk bars of one row left as lone bars; older-year fragments on kerbs

boxes_read.box: m2100 15th St, in a tower's shadow in 2022
boxes_read.what: false: marks on a low roof / deck beside the street (inside the 16 m look-window, lidar ground within 1.5 m); many small marks that exist only under the 2022 shadow gain; older-year fragments
crosswalks, stop bars and the dotted turn guides read; false: island kerbs as short lines

boxes_read.box: m3500 Speer southbound, a mid-block crossing
boxes_read.what: false: the gutter pan along the kerb read as a long bar; a mark on the lawn; misses: lane dashes partly under vehicles' shadows

causes_and_fixes: the look-window was a flat 16 m about every OSM line: now lanes x 3.5 m / 2 + 4.5 m per way (never over 16 m), with 18 m discs at junction nodes (paint_read.window)
a mark needed lidar ground within 1.5 m: now 0.75 m (roofs and decks beside the street)
a lone bar / stop bar / line that the 2020 lidar contradicts while the 2020 picture shows it is graded detected (gutter pans, slab edges)

an untyped small mark read only under the 2022 shadow gain is dropped; a short older-year bar with nothing in 2022 is treated as a fragment (kept only if both older years show it and 2022 is hidden there)
